640:t_1:4.en:
$$ロシウ$$
「...This past month went by in no time at all, didn't it?」

640:t_1:6.en:
$$ロシウ$$
「You set out tomorrow, correct? For the center of the galaxy.」

640:t_1:7.en:
$$シモン$$
「The main $$サイデリアル$$ force... and the battle against $$バアル$$ are waiting for us there.」

640:t_1:8.en:
$$シモン$$
「But unless we settle things with them, true peace will never come.」

640:t_1:9.en:
$$ロシウ$$
「And if we leave them alone, the $$サイデリアル$$ will just attack Earth again.」

640:t_1:10.en:
$$シモン$$
「On top of that, I hear the abnormal outbreak of $$バアル$$ at the galactic center has reached a level that can't compare to when we got thrown out there before.」

640:t_1:11.en:
$$シモン$$
「This has to be a sign of the great collapse of the universe that comes once every 120 million years. There's no doubt about it.」

640:t_1:12.en:
$$ロシウ$$
「Learning about the state of the galaxy through mutual understanding with the $$ＥＬＳ#keyword$$ was a big deal.」

640:t_1:13.en:
$$シモン$$
「Their home planet was destroyed by $$バアル$$ too... So they say they'll help us take it down.」

640:t_1:14.en:
$$ロシウ$$
「I'd like us to coordinate with organizations like the $$人類銀河同盟$$ as well, though...」

640:t_1:15.en:
$$シモン$$
「I'll try that once we get to the center of the galaxy.」

640:t_1:16.en:
$$ロシウ$$
「We were able to connect hearts with the $$ＥＬＳ#keyword$$ and the $$バジュラ$$ too. I'm sure it's possible.」

640:t_1:17.en:
$$シモン$$
「The galactic center, where we think $$バアル$$ nest... Win there, and we can surely stop the collapse of the universe that comes every 120 million years.」

640:t_1:18.en:
$$シモン$$
「$$ロシウ$$... Look after Earth while we're gone.」

640:t_1:19.en:
$$ロシウ$$
「Just in case, the residents of the colonies, $$翠の地球$$ and Mars have been evacuated to $$蒼の地球$$.」

640:t_1:20.en:
$$ロシウ$$
「Humanity intends to use all its remaining forces to defend this $$蒼の地球$$.」

640:t_1:21.en:
$$シモン$$
「The ones taking in evacuees at the $$新世界大陸$$ are the $$プラント$$ people and the people of the $$残されの海$$, right?」

640:t_1:22.en:
$$ロシウ$$
「$$獣人$$s and humans live together here. There's ground here for accepting anyone who comes.」

640:t_1:23.en:
$$ロシウ$$
「Though the people of the $$残されの海$$ seem to be struggling with life on land for the first time in their lives.」

640:t_1:24.en:
$$シモン$$
「Even $$レド$$ and $$エイミー$$ got used to life with $c. Those folks can surely do it too.」

640:t_1:25.en:
$$ニア$$
「It seems you've finished saying goodbye to $$ロシウ$$, $$シモン$$.」

640:t_1:26.en:
$$シモン$$
「...I'll ask you one last time, $$ニア$$. You're really coming with $c?」

640:t_1:27.en:
$$ニア$$
「...In $$超銀河ダイグレン$$, trapped in the other dimension, I kept thinking.」

640:t_1:28.en:
$$ニア$$
「What will I do if I never get to see $$シモン$$ again...?」

640:t_1:30.en:
$$ニア$$
「Neither the world nor I can be sure of tomorrow. So I decided I will never leave $$シモン$$'s side again.」

640:t_1:31.en:
$$シモン$$
「Got it. I don't want to let go of you either, $$ニア$$.」

640:t_1:32.en:
$$シモン$$
「When it's all over and Earth is at peace...」

640:t_1:34.en:
$$シモン$$
「Then let's hold a wedding. And invite all our precious friends.」

640:t_1:35.en:
$$ニア$$
「Hearing that, I feel I absolutely have to come back.」

640:t_1:36.en:
$$ロシウ$$
「Then please let me serve as your witness when that time comes.」

640:t_1:39.en:
$$ロシウ$$
「...You'll win, won't you, $$シモン$$?」

640:t_1:40.en:
$$シモン$$
「Who do you think I am?」

640:t_1:41.en:
$$ロシウ$$
「You're $$シモン$$. No matter where you go or who you're up against.」

640:t_1:42.en:
$$シモン$$
「Yeah...! I'll come back for sure, with victory as a souvenir.」

640:t_1:46.en: ～ $$ソレスタルビーイング号$$, Onboard Facilities ～

640:t_1:47.en:
$$バナージ$$
「...So you guys, $$ワッ太$$... have spent this whole month running a space odd-jobs business...?」

640:t_1:48.en:
$$ワッ太$$
「There's the preparation for our trip to the galaxy too, so I really wanted to take it easy, you know.」

640:t_1:49.en:
$$勝平$$
「What're you talking about, President? Compared to when we were whining about having no work, this is a happy problem!」

640:t_1:50.en:
$$万丈$$
「$$蒼の地球$$ was swamped everywhere with reconstruction and taking in evacuees.」

640:t_1:51.en:
$$正太郎$$
「That's why every single Super Robot got drafted to help out.」

640:t_1:52.en:
$$葵$$
「I never imagined I'd be doing construction work in $$ダンクーガ$$.」

640:t_1:53.en:
$$赤木$$
「Quit grumbling, $$葵$$. I had way more fun with that kind of work than with fighting.」

640:t_1:54.en:
$$タケル$$
「But thanks to your hard work, the job finished far sooner than expected, and Director $$大塚$$ was happy about it too.」

640:t_1:55.en:
$$アポロ$$
「Now we can go wild out in the galaxy to our hearts' content with nothing holding us back.」

640:t_1:56.en:
$$ロジャー$$
「Still, speaking of rapid changes this past month, the reconciliation between Earth and space is unforgettable too.」

640:t_1:57.en:
$$カミーユ$$
「I think it's because people's awareness changed once $$クロノ$$'s existence and its doctrine were revealed.」

640:t_1:58.en:
$$ガロード$$
「Besides, now that we've even made friends with the $$ＥＬＳ#keyword$$, humans fighting each other would just be embarrassing.」

640:t_1:59.en:
$$ロラン$$
「It also mattered a lot that $$ディアナ$$, Her Highness $$ミネバ$$ and Vice Foreign Minister $$ドーリアン$$ and the others bridged Earth and space.」

640:t_1:60.en:
$$リディ$$
「Are you sure, $$バナージ$$? Not going to see $$ミネバ$$ before tomorrow's departure?」

640:t_1:61.en:
$$バナージ$$
「We talked a lot the other day, so I'm fine.」

640:t_1:62.en:
$$バナージ$$
(I'll come back to you for sure... I'll keep that promise, $$オードリー$$...)

640:t_1:63.en:
$$刹那$$
「Are you sure about it too, $$ヒイロ$$? You don't seem to have met Vice Foreign Minister $$ドーリアン$$.」

640:t_1:64.en:
$$ヒイロ$$
「I have no particular business with the Vice Foreign Minister.」

640:t_1:65.en:
$$ヒイロ$$
「All I'm going to do is win peace.」

640:t_1:67.en:
$$アムロ$$
「If we're at the stage called the civilization of fire, then we have a mission to connect it to the future.」

640:t_1:68.en:
$$シャア$$
「All the more reason we can't let this world... come to an end.」

640:t_1:69.en:
$$ハマーン$$
「The power to do that... A fleet that gathers all of humanity sets sail tomorrow.」

640:t_1:70.en:
$$キラ$$
「The great collapse of the universe that comes once every 120 million years... And the $$バアル$$ that swarm as its precursor...」

640:t_1:71.en:
$$シン$$
「Put the other way, if we just defeat those $$バアル$$, the great collapse won't happen, right?」

640:t_1:72.en:
$$ガムリン$$
「If you interpret the records left in various ruins, starting with the $$プロトカルチャー$$ ones, that's how it works out.」

640:t_1:73.en:
$$レド$$
「And now that the $$ＥＬＳ#keyword$$ have revealed that the $$宇宙怪獣$$' nest is at the center of the galaxy...」

640:t_1:74.en:
$$レド$$
「We'll fight the decisive battle there, staking humanity... the fate of the whole galaxy.」

640:t_1:75.en:
$$桂$$
「Still, just because of who we're up against, I can't believe they built something like that in a single month.」

640:t_1:76.en:
$$オルソン$$
「It was originally part of the Earth defense plan that had been in progress since the $$時獄戦役$$...」

640:t_1:77.en:
$$オルソン$$
「I hear the design proceeded based on the data inside $$ノリコ$$'s $$ガンバスター$$.」

640:t_1:78.en:
$$シャア$$
「Its structure and systems are unique, and compared to the original, it has even been successfully miniaturized.」

640:t_1:80.en:
$$ルナマリア$$
「Thinking about how huge the real one was makes my head spin...」

640:t_1:81.en:
$$ロジャー$$
「I hear the research data that $$レナード・テスタロッサ$$ left behind was also a great help in developing it.」

640:t_1:82.en:
$$ロジャー$$
「What's more, I hear he also had data on the ruins at the edge of the Solar System that the $$サイデリアル$$ held.」

640:t_1:84.en:
$$ワッ太$$
「Is that the mysterious dimensional distortion the $$クラッシャー隊$$ has been investigating?」

640:t_1:85.en:
$$タケル$$
「That's right. We haven't heard the details either, but apparently an ancient civilization's fleet was left there intact.」
